basic_info.description: Luxury Downtown Condo with Stunning Views - Under $600K! Experience breathtaking downtown views from this spacious high-floor one-bedroom condo at 1 Hawthorneone of the most sought-after addresses in the city! This smartly designed home boasts an open-concept layout with a separate den area, ideal for a home office. Enjoy premium features including Bosch appliances, a large soaking tub, a walk-in closet, and in-unit washer/dryer, plus the comfort of central air conditioning. Situated in an unbeatable downtown location, you're just minutes from luxury shopping, world-class dining, and top cultural attractions. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity, schedule your private tour today!
